about: UCT Agent NL & Intent HELD-OUT evaluation set v1 (2026-10-13). Written blind to the Agent's matcher/routing code, from the capability catalogue + corpus fixture/library names only, to test wording nobody tuned for. Same shape and fixtures as corpus.json. split 'adversarial' = near-miss wording that tempts a wrong action. ideal 'fast' only when the words + fixture fully determine the outcome. ops[].args is a SUBSET to match (left out when not certain of exact enum/shape); expect.alt lists other acceptable op sets; empty ops with kind 'act' + note 'needs indicator edit capability' marks a capability gap (no catalogue action edits an existing indicator's inputs).
